national_news.title: Logo and Mascot Unveiled for 8th Khelo India Youth Games in Telangana
bullets: Union Youth Affairs and Sports Minister Dr. Mansukh Mandaviya and Telangana CM A. Revanth Reddy unveiled the official logo and mascot for the 8th Khelo India Youth Games.
The multi-sport event will be held across six cities in Telangana, featuring 29 sporting disciplines (27 competitive sports and 2 demonstration events).
Approximately 8,000 athletes and participants are expected to participate, supporting national goals such as 'Nasha Mukt Yuva for Viksit Bharat'.

national_news.title: Nation Observes Janjatiya Gaurav Diwas to Mark Birsa Munda's Birth Anniversary
bullets: Janjatiya Gaurav Diwas was celebrated across India on November 15 to honor the legacy of iconic tribal freedom fighter Bhagwan Birsa Munda.
During the events, the ₹1,353 crore Dahi Micro Irrigation Lift Project was dedicated in Madhya Pradesh, while new Eklavya Model Residential Schools were inaugurated in Jharkhand.
Manipur launched the State-Level Tribal Cultural Festival in Imphal to highlight and preserve the rich traditions, art, and identity of tribal communities.

national_news.title: 49th ASEAN Summit Begins in Manila; India to Attend ASEAN-India and East Asia Summits
bullets: The 49th ASEAN Summit kicked off in Manila, Philippines under the theme 'Navigating Our Future, Together'.
PM Narendra Modi is scheduled to participate in the 23rd ASEAN-India Summit and the 21st East Asia Summit to strengthen India's Comprehensive Strategic Partnership.
The summit addresses regional security, economic cooperation, and maritime issues, with the Philippines handing over the ASEAN chairmanship to Singapore.

national_news.title: India and Egypt Work Towards Bilateral Trade Agreement and Local Currency Trade
bullets: Union Commerce and Industry Minister Piyush Goyal co-chaired the 7th India-Egypt Joint Trade Committee meeting in Cairo with Egypt's Minister of Investment and Foreign Trade, Mohamed Farid Saleh.

The central banks of both nations are actively working to promote bilateral trade in local currencies and explore linking India's Unified Payments Interface (UPI) with Egypt's digital payment infrastructure.
A joint team was established to finalize the Terms of Reference (ToR) in a time-bound manner for a comprehensive bilateral trade agreement spanning healthcare, fintech, engineering, and agriculture.

national_news.title: NFDC to Organise 20th Edition of WAVES Film Bazaar Alongside 57th IFFI in Goa
bullets: The National Film Development Corporation (NFDC), functioning under the Ministry of Information and Broadcasting, is hosting the 20th edition of WAVES Film Bazaar in Goa.
The platform aims to promote South Asian cinema globally through initiatives like the Co-Production Market, Screenwriters' Lab, Work-in-Progress Lab, and Market Screenings.
Since its inception in 2007, Film Bazaar has supported notable Indian films such as 'The Lunchbox', 'Newton', and 'Manto', alongside financial support from NFDC for over 300 regional language films.

national_news.title: Union Minister Amit Shah Announces Dec 2027 Deadline for NHEC Revival in Pune
bullets: Union Minister of Cooperation Amit Shah set December 2027 as the target deadline to commence production at the revived National Heavy Engineering Cooperative Limited (NHEC) plant in Pune.
The revival initiative is funded by cooperative organizations including NDDB, Amul, IFFCO, NCDC, and NAFED to produce heavy equipment for sugar, dairy, ethanol, CBG, railway, and defence sectors.
Launched 'Bharat Taxi', a driver-owned cooperative taxi service in Mumbai, Nashik, and Pune aimed at eliminating commission deductions for drivers.

national_news.title: India Clinches Record Ninth Men’s U-19 Asia Cup Title
bullets: India defeated Pakistan by one wicket in Muscat, Oman, to win the Men’s Under-19 Asia Cup title for a record-extending ninth time.
Mohit Ulva was named Player of the Match for his unbeaten 49 off 26 deliveries, while Aaryavir Sehwag won Player of the Tournament.
India successfully chased a target of 338 runs, sealing victory on the final ball of the match.

national_news.title: Defence Minister Emphasizes Strengthening Indigenous Non-Destructive Testing Ecosystem
bullets: Defence Minister Rajnath Singh addressed the 36th Annual Conference on Non-Destructive Evaluation & Enabling Technologies and the 15th International Symposium on NDT in Aerospace.
Highlighted the strategic role of Non-Destructive Testing (NDT) technologies in detecting internal structural defects without causing physical damage to critical defence and space equipment.
Urged domestic industry, MSMEs, and defence PSUs to build indigenous capabilities in specialized sensors, evaluation equipment, and software to reduce import dependencies.

national_news.title: Union Minister Announces 5 Lakh PMAY-G Houses and Lakhpati Didi Initiatives in Odisha
bullets: Union Minister for Rural Development Shivraj Singh Chouhan announced 5 lakh additional pucca houses for Odisha under the Pradhan Mantri Awas Yojana–Gramin (PMAY-G).

Odisha achieved its Lakhpati Didi target ahead of schedule with 29 lakh women reaching the status; the Centre announced plans to extend ₹10 lakh crore in bank loans nationwide over five years without collateral requirement.
The Union Government announced joint Centre-State subsidies for installing solar panels on PMAY-G homes to reduce electricity bills and generate additional income from surplus power.

national_news.title: Government Data and KPMG Report Highlight Digital Skilling Imperative for MSME Sector
bullets: Government figures show the MSME sector contributes 31.1% to India's GDP, 35.4% to manufacturing output, 48.58% to exports, and employs over 38.9 crore people.
Total registrations on the Udyam portal crossed 8.7 crore by June 2026, facilitating formal credit access and participation in public tenders.
A 2026 KPMG report revealed that only 10% of the MSME workforce is formally skilled, with productivity at 14% of large enterprises and 45% of core skills projected to shift by 2030.

national_news.title: COAS General Dhiraj Seth Embarks on Official Visit to Czech Republic
bullets: Chief of the Army Staff (COAS) General Dhiraj Seth undertook an official visit to the Czech Republic from November 16 to 19 to strengthen bilateral defence and military cooperation.
The itinerary includes interactions at the Defence University in Brno and the NATO Joint Chemical, Biological, Radiological and Nuclear (CBRN) Defence Centre of Excellence.
The visit follows the bilateral defence meeting held in October 2026 under the India-Czech Joint Defence Committee framework to boost 'Make in India' in defence manufacturing.

national_news.title: Ministry of Information & Broadcasting Merges PIB and Central Bureau of Communication
bullets: The Ministry of Information and Broadcasting (MIB) issued an order merging the Press Information Bureau (PIB) and the Central Bureau of Communication (CBC) into a unified entity.
The merged organization will operate under the PIB banner and be headed by the Director General (Coordination), PIB, reporting to the Chairman of the Communication Board.
The merger consolidates government news dissemination, advertising, multi-media outreach, exhibitions, print publicity, and fact-checking under a single administrative framework.

national_news.title: Sacred Relics of Lord Buddha Arrive at Golden Pagoda in Namsai, Arunachal Pradesh
bullets: The Sacred Relics of Shakyamuni Buddha arrived at the Golden Pagoda (Kongmu Kham) in Namsai, Arunachal Pradesh, marking the third and final phase of their exposition in the state.

The event was organized jointly by the Ministry of Culture, Government of India, the Government of Arunachal Pradesh, the National Museum (New Delhi), and the International Buddhist Confederation (IBC).

As part of the exposition, two special exhibitions were inaugurated, including 'Unearthing the Sacred Piprahwa: The Story of the Holy Buddha Relics and Their Discovery' by the National Museum and the IBC.

bihar_news.title: 19.76-Km Kachi Dargah–Bidupur Ganga Bridge Named 'Nitish Setu'
bullets: The 19.76-kilometre long, six-lane corridor connecting Patna and Vaishali districts in Bihar has been officially named 'Nitish Setu' in honour of former CM Nitish Kumar.
The major infrastructure project, which connects North and South Bihar across the River Ganga, was conceptualised in 2012 and its foundation stone was laid in 2016.
The bridge corridor is scheduled to be dedicated to the nation by Prime Minister Narendra Modi on November 21.

bihar_news.title: NPPA Extends Ceiling Prices for Orthopaedic Knee Implants Till January 2027
bullets: The National Pharmaceutical Pricing Authority (NPPA), under the Ministry of Chemicals and Fertilizers, extended the validity of ceiling prices for orthopaedic knee implants until January 15, 2027.
The ceiling prices were first notified in August 2017 under the provisions of the Drugs (Prices Control) Order (DPCO) to maintain uniform and affordable pricing for patients.
Knee implant manufacturers and importers are required to submit relevant operational and pricing data via the Knee Implant Data Collection module on the IPDMS 2.0 Portal.

bihar_news.title: Rs 5,000-Crore Kacchi Dargah-Bidupur Six-Lane Bridge Infrastructure Details Released
bullets: The Kacchi Dargah–Bidupur six-lane Ganga bridge, constructed at a cost exceeding Rs 5,000 crore, connects Patna (South Bihar) with Raghopur/Bidupur (North Bihar).
The project is funded via a Rs 3,000 crore loan from the Asian Development Bank (ADB), while the remaining Rs 2,000 crore was contributed from the state government's resources.
Sanctioned in 2015 with construction initiated in 2016, the bridge serves as a major transit link between North and South Bihar.

bihar_news.title: Patna Municipal Corporation Issues Bihar's First Municipal Bond of ₹200 Crore on NSE
bullets: Patna Municipal Corporation (PMC) became the first urban local body in Bihar to list a municipal bond on the National Stock Exchange (NSE).
The PMC raised ₹200 crore, comprising a base issue of ₹100.03 crore and a green-shoe option of ₹99.96 crore, receiving over double the subscription from institutional investors.
The raised capital will finance 15 key urban redevelopment and civic infrastructure projects across Patna.
